name: sops-age-secrets
description: MANDATORY SOPS+age for secrets in git. Classify first: GENERAL → holding-general-secrets (SOPS); PRODUCT → product repo (SOPS). OS-agnostic encrypt/decrypt. ADR 0003 + ADR 0004.
author: Marcus Vinícius de Lima (holding)

usage.aiAssistants: Classify every secret first. General → holding-general-secrets. Product → SOPS+age via this skill (allowlist → secrets.enc.yaml; decrypt → secrets.env). Never commit age.key or plaintext env.
usage.engineers: SOPS+age encrypt/decrypt workflow for holding repositories. Canonical scripts live under dev-host/scripts until extracted.
usage.founders: The only approved way to put secrets in git for multi-machine use across the holding (ADR 0003).
